meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解书面计划、并行推进执行,并为每个步骤留下证据。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一份写好的计划,想让多个自动化帮手照章执行、边做边向你交代进度。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written plan into tracked parallel agent execution.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a concrete plan and want helpers to run it in parallel with clear progress logs.

howto.what: Claude 不再自己写代码，而是当调度者：读 .omo/plans/ 里的 Prometheus 计划，把实现、测试、评审全部派给子代理并行执行，用 .omo/boulder.json 记录进度，逐条勾掉计划复选框，直到顶层复选框全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说 “ulw-execute”，或要求执行 .omo/plans 下的某份计划时触发；若没有可用计划，会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再开始执行。

say.note: 选中并开始执行该计划
每个阶段以 pull request 交付
跟进 PR 直到合并

howto.what_en: Claude stops coding itself: it reads a Prometheus plan in .omo/plans/, delegates implementation, tests and review to parallel subagents, tracks state in .omo/boulder.json, and checks off plan boxes until all top-level ones are done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "ulw-execute" or ask it to run a .omo/plans plan; with no usable plan it first calls ulw-plan to create one.

say_en.note: Delivers each phase as a pull request
Follows the PR through to merge
